# Kleo - Language Learning App
# https://www.meetkleo.com

> Kleo is an interactive language learning app that combines video lessons with AI-powered speech recognition to help users become fluent speakers.

## About Kleo
Kleo offers immersive language learning through interactive video conversations with native speakers. Unlike traditional apps, Kleo focuses on speaking practice with real-time pronunciation feedback.

## Supported Languages
- German
- Italian
- Spanish
- Ukrainian (free)

## Key Features
- Interactive video lessons with native speakers
- AI-powered speech recognition and pronunciation feedback
- Real conversation practice in everyday situations
- Personalized learning paths
- Hands-free practice mode

## Pricing
- Free tier: Several lessons per language
- Weekly: $4.99/week
- Monthly: $9.99/month
- 6-Month: $29.99/6 months
- Ukrainian course: Completely free
